name: orca-sessions
title: Orca Sessions
description: Browse, focus, prompt and manage Orca agent sessions (worktrees and terminals) from Raycast.
author: myksyut

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Search Orca Sessions
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: List Orca worktrees and their agents; focus, send prompts, read output, manage.

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Orca Session
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Create a new Orca worktree, optionally launching an agent with an initial prompt.

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Orca Sessions Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Show agent session states in the menu bar and jump to any session.

preferences.name: orcaPath
preferences.title: Orca CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the `orca` CLI. Defaults to the one bundled inside Orca.app.

preferences.name: defaultAgent
preferences.title: Default Agent
preferences.description: Agent launched by default when creating a new session or terminal.

preferences.name: showArchived
preferences.title: Sessions List
preferences.label: Show archived worktrees
preferences.description: Include archived worktrees in the sessions list.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
